description: WTGs must maintain a 1 nautical mile setback from the outer boundary of the southeastbound traffic lane of the current Traffic Separation Scheme.
context_quote: Based on USCG recommendations in the New Jersey Port Access Route Study (PARS), US Wind's proposed layout included a 1 nmi (1.9 km) setback from the outer boundary of the southeastbound traffic lane of the current Traffic Separation Scheme for the southeastern approach to the Delaware Bay or its proposed extension, which removed 7 of the 121 WTG positions, resulting in a total of up to 114 WTGs.

description: No surface occupancy within 14 miles from shore, excluding 32 WTG positions and 1 OSS.
context_quote: Under Alternative D, no surface occupancy would occur within 14 miles (22.5-kilometers) from shore, resulting in the exclusion of 32 WTG positions and one OSS.

description: Removal or realignment of up to 11 WTG positions to avoid habitat areas of concern.
context_quote: Under Alternative E, removal of up to 11 WTG positions, removal/realignment of associated inter-array cables (if applicable), realignment of the offshore export cables, and relocation of the Met Tower would avoid the identified AOCs.

description: Avoidance of cable routes through Indian River Bay to minimize impacts on sensitive habitats.
context_quote: Alternative C would result in the elimination of approximately 168.3 acres of temporary seafloor disturbance in Indian River Bay associated with cable installation and 39 acres associated with dredging for barge access, but would include wetland impacts that are not present in Alternative B.
